annotations.title: Confirm a channel with its code

description:
Enter the 6-digit code the channel received. Turns the channel on and adds it to alert_id (and to any alert named when it was added). Ask the person for the code; never guess. Five wrong codes need a new code.

Permission: channels:manage.

alert_id.description: Also add the channel to this alert.

name: confirm_channel

code.description: The pending confirmation code, while awaiting_code.

detail.description: For text messages, the last four digits. Destinations and credentials are never returned.

price_micros_per_message.description: 30000 ($0.03) per text message from the prepaid balance; 0 for other types.

status.description: awaiting_code: added but not confirmed, so nothing is sent. opted_out: the number replied STOP. One of: "awaiting_code", "on", "paused", "opted_out", "needs_reconnect".

title: Confirm a channel with its code
